# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** 15  <sub>[v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is fair with long sleek curls that never get out of order, gentle and mild hazel eyes, and a straight nose. She has a "prunes and prisms" mouth and always looks starched, neat, and proper.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is quiet, prim, well-behaved, and composed, remaining calm and placid even during scary or emotional situations. She is very neat, systematic, industrious, and helpful around the house, never forgetting her duties. However, her subdued and orderly nature can make her seem somewhat monotonous or machine-like to others.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_

## History

Dora and her twin brother Davy were orphaned at a young age after their father died and their sick mother passed away. Marilla Cuthbert took them into Green Gables, where Dora proved to be an exceptionally well-behaved, obedient, and helpful child compared to her mischievous brother. She began attending school alongside Davy and made friends, such as planning to sit with Lily Sloane. Over the years, she grew into a sensible, careful, and womanly fifteen-year-old girl who assisted around Green Gables. When Anne Shirley left Green Gables after her marriage, Dora was chosen to inherit Anne's former porch room.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_
